Game Overview

Funny Escape is a casual game built around embark on a comical escape quest where quick thinking is your best ally. Dash through obstacles, outsmart cunning red guards, and solve puzzles to unlock your path. Can you collect stars and find the key before time runs out? Experience laughter and adrenaline in every vibrant, fast-paced route!
